newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on returning payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on returning payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Monday as market liquidity loosened on routine payments returning to the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.657 percent against Saturday's 7.047 close -- outside the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone but far below the record double-digit closes of late June.
The 30-day commercial paper was at 6.50 percent against 6.75.
Dealers said they expected the rates to continue falling on the scheduled maturation of T$18 billion worth of negotiable certificates of deposit later this week.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.9875-9890 percent against 5.9650-9680.
